reviews.review_title: Game so good it praised me in many ways
reviews.review_description:
Paid my bills. Then gave me $47,000 and a brand new refrigerator. Haven’t checked my bank account since. 10/10.
My grandma came back. She said she was proud of me and then disappeared again. Incredible experience.
Changed my oil and fixed my credit score. I don’t even own a car. Absolute masterpiece.
Ordered a large pizza and got a college degree instead. Slightly disappointed there were no pepperoni, but overall amazing.
My WiFi went from 12 Mbps to 9,000 Mbps after installing this. My router is now legally considered a NASA supercomputer.
I downloaded this and my taxes disappeared. The IRS called me and apologized. 5 stars.

My Favorite story
I originally downloaded Primal because I wanted to play something with my friends after school. I saw the little gorilla guy and figured it was basically Fall Guys and Gorilla Tag combined, which sounded fun.

I joined my first match and immediately got launched off the map.

Fair enough.

I joined another one and somehow made it to the final round. I was running around, jumping over obstacles, climbing walls, swinging around, getting chased by 14 gorillas, and generally having the time of my life.

Then I lost.

I took my headset off and went downstairs.

My mom asked me why I was running around the house with my arms up.

I told her I was playing Primal.

She looked at me for a few seconds and said, “Oh, so you’re the one.”

I had no idea what she meant.

The next day at school, my science teacher walked into class wearing a PrimalVR shirt.

I asked him why.

He said, “You didn’t qualify.”

I asked what I didn’t qualify for.

He wouldn’t answer.

At lunch, one of my friends came up to me and said we had to form a team of four because “the next round starts at 3.”

I thought he was joking.

He wasn’t.

At 3:00 PM, I opened PrimalVR.

There was a tournament lobby I had never seen before.

My friend was already in it.

Somehow my science teacher was also there.

We played.

We won the first round.

We won the second round.

We made it to the final.

The final was absolute chaos. Everyone was jumping everywhere, climbing, swinging, knocking each other off platforms, and trying to survive while the entire map basically turned into a giant playground.

We somehow won.

My headset said “VICTORY.”

I took it off.

My science teacher texted me:

“Good work.”

I don’t have my science teacher’s phone number.

I haven’t opened Primal since.

I’m slightly concerned that I may have accidentally joined some sort of professional VR obstacle-course league without realizing it.

But honestly?

Best game I’ve played all year.

5 stars. The movement is fun, the rounds are chaotic, and getting launched off a platform by a gorilla while 15 people are screaming is exactly what I wanted from VR.

I still don’t know what my science teacher was talking about.

Would absolutely get eliminated again. 🦍😭⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
